description: Philippines pathway following National Renewable Energy Plan with some offshore wind development.

coreDrivers.policies: Enhanced energy-efficiency, renewable-energy, alternative-fuel and emerging-technology measures supporting the NDC.
coreDrivers.emissionsTargets: 21.7% cumulative reduction from REF and energy-sector emissions offset by 2037.
coreDrivers.technologyCosts: Affordability, financing and aggregate build cost for clean-energy technologies.
coreDrivers.investmentChange: Part of a collective USD477.4 billion CES1/CES2 build requirement.
coreDrivers.macroeconomicDrivers: Clean transition balanced with affordability, reliability, energy security and development.
coreDrivers.behavioralShifts: Stronger implementation of energy-efficiency practices and stakeholder participation.
coreDrivers.otherDrivers: Climate finance, technology transfer, institutional capacity and resilience.
